title: Faisal Town Islamabad Map & Location – Phase 1 vs Phase 2
description: Find the correct Faisal Town Islamabad map and location for Phase 1/F-18 and Phase 2/FT-II, with access guidance, master plans and plot verification.
h1: Faisal Town Islamabad Map & Location – Phase 1 vs Phase 2
intro:
Faisal Town Islamabad map searches can refer to two different projects: the established Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 development and the newer Faisal Town Phase 2/FT-II project.

Use the correct project map before comparing plots, prices or access. Phase 1 uses Block A, Block B and Block C references, while Phase 2 uses sector and enclave references such as Sector O, P, R, S, T and Overseas Enclave.
body:
## Faisal Town Islamabad map overview

“Faisal Town Islamabad” can refer to more than one Faisal Town development, so the first step is identifying the correct project before using a map.

For this website, the two main references are:

- Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18
- Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II

The two projects use different layouts, naming systems and location references.

Phase 1 is commonly searched through block names such as Block A, Block B and Block C.

Phase 2 uses a much larger sector-based master plan with sectors, enclaves and project-wide road corridors.

Do not use one project's map to identify a plot in the other.

## Faisal Town Phase 1 / F-18 location

Faisal Town Phase 1 is the established Faisal Town development associated with Islamabad Sector F-18 and the surrounding Fateh Jang Road / N-80 area.

The Phase 1 project is organized around established block references including:

- Block A
- Block B
- Block C

Individual block pages should be used when comparing exact plot locations.

For a Phase 1 property, verify:

- block
- plot number
- street number
- road width
- access route
- corner or main-road position
- possession
- surrounding occupancy

The Phase 1 map is the correct starting point for Block A, B or C searches.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 / FT-II location

Faisal Town Phase 2 is a separate, newer Faisal Town project with a much larger sector-based master plan.

The current Faisal Town-hosted Phase II master plan is dated 10 April 2025.

The published plan visibly references major location features including:

- M-2 Motorway
- motorway direction toward Islamabad
- motorway direction toward Lahore
- Rawalpindi Ring Road interchange
- Chakri Road interchange
- Main Chakri Road
- Lake District
- golf club
- future extension areas

These references make the Phase 2 master plan useful for understanding the broader project location and road relationships.

However, a master plan should be used for orientation only. Exact plot identification still requires the relevant sector plan, plot number and on-ground verification.

## Phase 1 vs Phase 2 map difference

The biggest mistake buyers can make is assuming that every “Faisal Town Islamabad” map refers to the same project.

Phase 1 and Phase 2 use different naming systems.

### Phase 1

Phase 1 commonly uses block names such as:

- Block A
- Block B
- Block C

### Phase 2

Phase 2 uses sector and enclave references such as:

- Sector O / Model Block
- Sector P / The Caladan
- Sector R
- Sector S
- Sector T
- Overseas Enclave

If a listing says only “Block P,” “O Block” or another unclear label, ask the seller which phase and master plan applies.

## Which Faisal Town map should you use?

Use the Phase 1/F-18 map if you are checking:

- Block A
- Block B
- Block C
- an established Phase 1 house or plot

Use the Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan if you are checking:

- Sector O
- Sector P
- Sector R
- Sector S
- Sector T
- Overseas Enclave
- another FT-II sector

Once you identify the correct project, use the most specific sector or block map available.

The more specific the map, the more useful it becomes for comparing roads, street position and nearby land use.

## Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan

The current Phase II master-plan PDF available from Faisal Town is dated 10 April 2025.

The plan is useful for understanding the overall FT-II layout and major road relationships.

It shows broad project features including:

- residential sectors
- major road corridors
- M-2 Motorway
- Ring Road-related interchanges
- Chakri Road access
- Lake District
- green and recreational areas
- future extensions

Use the master plan to understand where a sector sits within the wider development.

Then use the individual sector plan or exact plot reference before making a booking or resale decision.

## Google Maps vs project master plan

Google Maps and a project master plan serve different purposes.

Google Maps is useful for:

- driving routes
- approximate travel time
- current road navigation
- nearby towns or landmarks
- live map pins

A project master plan is useful for:

- sector or block identification
- plot layout
- internal road relationships
- planned land use
- project boundaries

Neither should replace the other.

For a serious purchase decision, use both together and then physically verify the property.

## How to verify a plot on the map

Before paying a token, ask for:

- exact project name
- phase
- sector or block
- plot number
- street number
- plot dimensions
- marked map position
- Google Maps pin
- current site photos or live video

These references should agree with each other.

If a seller sends only a cropped screenshot, request the complete project or sector map.

A cropped image can hide the wider road layout or exact sector context.

## How to compare access before shortlisting

Do not compare two properties only by a single distance figure.

The practical route matters more.

For each property, compare:

- route from the project gate
- road condition
- current usable access
- connection to major roads
- traffic conditions
- distance to your regular destination
- future road dependence

For Phase 2, ask which approach road currently serves the sector you are considering.

For Phase 1, compare the actual block and street access.

## M-2 Motorway and Phase 2

The Faisal Town Phase II master plan directly shows the M-2 Motorway as a major location reference.

It also labels motorway directions toward Islamabad and Lahore, helping buyers understand the wider regional position of the project. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

Do not assume that every Phase 2 sector has identical access to the motorway.

The exact sector position and available road connection still matter.

## Rawalpindi Ring Road and Chakri Road

The Phase II master plan also marks Rawalpindi Ring Road-related road interchanges and Main Chakri Road.

These are important orientation points for understanding the wider Phase 2 location. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

Actual road usability, completion and travel time can change, so verify the current route before buying based on a future-access claim.

## Phase 1 map verification

For Phase 1, use the correct F-18 map and then confirm the exact block.

A Block A plot should not be compared with Block B or Block C only from an approximate pin.

Confirm:

- exact street
- plot dimensions
- road width
- possession
- nearby commercial area
- corner or main-road status
- physical surroundings

Established blocks can still have meaningful street-level differences.

## Phase 2 sector map verification

For Phase 2, begin with the full master plan and then move to the individual sector plan.

For example:

- Sector O buyers should use the Model Block / Sector O reference
- Sector P buyers should use the dedicated The Caladan plan
- Sector R buyers should request an exact marked sector position
- Overseas Enclave buyers should confirm the relevant enclave or sub-area

This avoids relying on a broad Phase 2 image when the real decision depends on one street or plot.

## Map verification before a token payment

Before paying a token or advance:

1. Confirm the project phase.
2. Confirm the block or sector.
3. Confirm the exact plot number.
4. Match it to the map.
5. Match the map to a current site pin.
6. Verify the physical location.
7. Confirm road width and special-location claims.
8. Verify ownership or booking documents.
9. Confirm outstanding dues.
10. Obtain payment and receipt instructions in writing.

If the map, plot number and paperwork do not match, do not proceed until the discrepancy is resolved.

## Regulatory and approval verification

A project map does not prove regulatory approval.

Before making a substantial payment, verify the current regulatory position independently with the relevant authority.

RDA previously issued enforcement notices relating to Faisal Town Phase II in 2023, so current status should be checked directly rather than inferred from marketing material or the existence of a master plan. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

Use the latest regulator information available at the time of purchase.

## Site visit before buying

A site visit remains one of the most useful checks.

Take the map and plot reference with you.

Confirm:

- access route
- plot location
- road width
- nearby construction
- plot level
- drainage
- surrounding land use
- corner or premium location
- physical development
- current accessibility

For a remote buyer, request a live video walkthrough and current map pin rather than relying only on an old recorded video.

## Phase 1 or Phase 2: which location suits you?

The answer depends on your objective.

Phase 1 may appeal more to buyers looking for an established block-based environment where actual streets, houses and resale inventory can be inspected.

Phase 2 may appeal more to buyers considering a larger developing project with multiple sectors, newer inventory and longer-term development potential.

Compare:

- budget
- plot size
- intended use
- development
- access
- possession
- payment structure
- total purchase cost

The project name alone should not decide the purchase.

faqsText:
Which Faisal Town Islamabad map do I need? | Use the Phase 1/F-18 map for Block A, Block B and Block C. Use the Phase 2/FT-II master plan for Phase 2 sectors and Overseas Enclave.

Is Faisal Town Phase 1 the same as Phase 2? | No. They are separate projects with different maps, naming systems and locations.

What is the date of the current Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan? | The Faisal Town-hosted Phase II master-plan PDF currently available is dated 10 April 2025.

Does the Phase 2 master plan show the M-2 Motorway? | Yes. The published plan labels the M-2 Motorway and motorway directions toward Islamabad and Lahore. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}

Does the Phase 2 map show Rawalpindi Ring Road access? | The published master plan labels road interchanges associated with Rawalpindi Ring Road and Chakri Road. Current practical access should still be verified on the ground. :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5}

Can I use Google Maps instead of the project map? | No. Google Maps is useful for routes and live location, but the project map is needed for block, sector and plot identification.

Should I trust a cropped map sent by an agent? | Use it only as an initial reference. Ask for the full project or sector plan and match it with the plot number and current site pin.

How do I verify a Faisal Town plot location? | Confirm the phase, block or sector, plot number, project map, current site pin and physical location before paying.

Can I download the Faisal Town Phase 2 master plan? | Yes. The current Phase II master-plan PDF on this page is dated 10 April 2025.

Should I check approval status before booking? | Yes. Verify the current regulatory position independently with the relevant authority before making payment.
